facts_verified.claim: The Connection: close lifetime repair lets real http.client read all 20000 bytes while preserving TLS verification, SNI, approved-address pinning, absolute deadlines and final resource closure.

Final cleanup is fail-closed: each resource receives at most two close attempts, a successful response cannot hide persistent cleanup failure, and post-TLS failures close the wrapped TLS owner instead of reusing the raw socket.
Persisted diagnostics are allowlisted to stage, stable code, exception class, errno and HTTP status; messages, request targets, URLs, headers, payloads and secrets are excluded.

All durable reservations and raw envelopes are inventoried before provider access. Proven repeated failures stop their sport across dispatches, ambiguous reservations are never counted as a proven failure, and full replay uses zero provider DNS or secret reads.

Effect guards bound each dispatch to 15 provider slots, 34 R2 exact-read GETs and 34 immutable PUTs; cumulative mission accounting retains one historical request and four reserved credits, uses zero automatic provider retry and stops before a new call on insufficient verified quota.
The final consolidated capture pack passed 101 tests with zero unapproved network attempts; Ruff and strict mypy passed on the final runtime diff.
evidence_refs: mypy strict on three runtime sources: PASS

main_objection: C4 VERDICT: PASS_AND_HOLD with P0=0 and P1=0. No open CRITICAL or HIGH security finding remains; merge and live execution retain exact-head, quota and durable-readback gates.

risks.risk: A TCP or TLS failure reached lazily from request() can be classified REQUEST_SEND instead of CONNECT, while still preserving stable class, errno and redaction.
A persistent close failure triggered by real http.client at EOF can surface as BODY_READ instead of CONNECTION_CLOSE; it remains fail-closed and cannot produce a false success.

minimum_decisive_test: Validate append-only records and review hashes, run the one full suite, require exact-head checks, then accept the live result only when immutable PUT/GET/hash/replay and the terminal receipt all pass.
recommended_action: PASS_AND_HOLD for C0 to complete evidence, normal PR and CI; dispatch only after merged-main, authority and cumulative-counter checks.
scale_condition: No scientific promotion. E3B remains only the operational authority ceiling for five endpoints and fifteen fixed slots.
estimated_compute: Targeted offline tests plus Ruff, strict mypy, Bandit, Git and secret checks; no provider call or corpus replay.
estimated_external_cost: 0 provider call, 0 credit, 0 R2 operation, 0 secret read, 0 purchase and 0 bet during C4 review.
estimated_human_time: Approximately 40 minutes of active review, excluding CI waits.
maintenance_impact: Existing TLS transport, secrets, conditional R2 storage and workflow are reused; no new runner, encryption, attestation or governance subsystem.
